exact_head_inline_findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require a complete not-disclosed envelope**

When the provider ends immediately after `===NOT_DISCLOSED===` or midway through its reason/followups, this check passes because no answer prose preceded the sentinel; the branch then substitutes the default reason or accepts the partial text and emits `complete`, causing the router to consume quota. Even after the new answer-mode missing-envelope guard, this separate path therefore still treats provider EOF as a valid publication boundary and can present truncation as a definitive “not disclosed” answer. Require a nonempty reason plus a complete, parseable followups envelope before completing this path.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
